bottleneck_analysis.primary_bottleneck: Readiness performs five downstream probes sequentially for every request.
bottleneck_analysis.gateway_observation: The profile used Envoy on port 8080; 200 responses indicate HTTP availability, not full readiness, because the response body was degraded while vLLM was unavailable.
bottleneck_analysis.recommendations: Cache dependency probe results for 1-2 seconds, keep liveness separate from readiness, and profile /api/v1/ask after the real vLLM gate passes.
